items.status: OPEN — filed 2026-10-12 (the owner's ask, mid-Order 51; repro on a kolt copy)
items.title: a FUNCTION called inside a `css { … }` block's chain-link arguments is painted wrong - `stroke1` in `.border(px(1), Theme::stroke1());` (kolt login_page.vl:97:26, a static call `Theme::stroke1()` as the second argument of the A69 chain link `.border(..)`) does not paint as a Function; a hole's ordinary vilan keeps its ordinary tokens by the css-block S5 pin (`space(4)` -> Function), so either the chain link's ARGUMENT spans are lost to the desugar's zero-width anchors (no semantic token, and TextMate's `css-items` rule colours the name as css) or the token lands with the wrong kind
items.discussion: the owner's ask (2026-10-12/13): "the function being incorrectly syntax highlighted at login_page.vl:97:26"; css-block S5 (vilan-lsp document.rs ~1526 `CssSpans`: properties, condition heads, A69's chain-link METHOD names - painted from the RAW parse because the desugar retires `Node::Css` before analysis and every generated accessor is zero-width; the pin `semantic_tokens_paint_a_css_block` ~16233: a hole keeps its ordinary tokens, `md` paints Method, `css` suppressed); A69 (chain links inside a block); A101 (css calls); the TextMate grammar `editors/vscode/syntaxes/vilan.tmLanguage.json` `#css` / `#css-items` (~615-676: inside a block an identifier is coloured as a property - the fallback that shows wherever the server sends no token); E115 (markup brackets); the semantic-token sweep's non-overlap invariant
items.body: Repro first on a kolt copy (lucide carried): `Document::semantic_tokens()` at the three spans `Theme`, `stroke1`, `px` on that line - say which kind each carries, or that none does. Expected: `Theme` Type, `stroke1` Function (a static call), `px` Function, `border` Method (A69), exactly as the same expression paints outside a block. Candidate causes: (a) the chain link's argument expressions are lowered under the desugar's zero-width anchors so the analyzed program carries no span for them (then the fix is the desugar keeping the arguments' REAL spans - they are ordinary vilan, the same rule as a property's hole - or the raw-parse walk painting them: an argument of a chain link is an expression, walked like a hole); (b) the token is there but the `::` path's segments are classified by the css walk's name rule (a chain-link method name painted Method by span adjacency swallowing `stroke1`). Also check a condition head's arguments and a nested block. If no server token covers the span, the TextMate `css-items` rule must also stop colouring a `::`-qualified name or a call as a property (the grammar is the fallback when semantic tokens are off: `vilan.semanticTokens.enabled = false`). Pins: this kolt shape, a static call as a property's hole, a call as a chain-link argument, a path inside a condition body, the grammar's regression test for the TextMate side (the website's keyword tests are the model). Sizing XS–S (document.rs css spans / the css desugar's spans; the tmLanguage css-items rule).
